campaign_summary: This outbound call campaign targets TELUS postpaid mobility customers who contacted care with expressed intent to add a line but did not complete the transaction, using a CCAI (voice analytics) signal to identify and retarget them. The offer is an Add-A-Line cross-sell delivered via outbound call in both English and French, with a 10% control holdout applied. Key ambiguities include an undefined CCAI list specification and a brand/cadence conflict between the tracking system (Koodo, Weekly) and the intake brief (TELUS, Triggered), and the dialing vendor has not been identified.
